comments.body:
Some advice I can give you:
It is very difficult to find a 'proper' job for just 2 Months. People don‘t like to train employees just for them to leave after they are trained.
Also I think it is not a good idea to work during your first year at ETH. You could work some if absolutely necessary but you will have no social life at all. Since the ETH has exams which you need to pass in blocks. Meaning you might have 5-6 classes which you need to pass with an average grade (avg over all classes) of more than 4.0. This means that, at least for the first few semesters, you won‘t be able to reduce the amount of classes you take in order to have time for work.
What could work out is doing things like food delivery. You might also be able to look into doing translation work. Since you know German (which is a huge plus for finding work).
If I were you I would start now with writing as many emails to language schools or even public schools to see if you can do some remote translation work.
I have a friend who randomly got asked by his local school to do translation from Portuguese to German and got payed 150.-/h.
comments.author: Laschibaschi
